column1: # tools/test/tests.tsv -- the tests tools/test/affected.rb can select, and those it names to exclude.
#   id       what affected.tsv and affected.rb name
#   kind     run       a short check: run it
#            long      run it, but it takes hours (the note says how long)
#            board     the board check; without RT1186_HOST its board-free
#                      parts run and the board part is a named skip
#            excluded  never selected to run: an oracle or a comparison with
#                      CRuby or its recordings, which the owner holds back
#                      until the 32-bit build runs on the board (2026-10-21),
#                      or a lane that runs only on such a comparison's build
#   command  how to run it from the repository root; DIR is a fresh directory
#            outside the checkout, BASE the base revision. The tools come
#            from the environment, as each suite's header says
#   note     why this test, or why it is excluded
# A selected test's own oracle sections stay gated: affected.rb lists them
